name: Desert Building
desc: A sun-baked pallet-rack and plywood desert structure with a patchwork facade, flickering window lights, a rising smoke plume and a drifting day-to-night tint.

style.doc: adobe=sun-baked patchwork facade with grain + raking shadow / blueprint=schematic white-on-blue line drawing (abstract) / riso=two-ink misregistered halftone / noir=chiaroscuro monochrome / thermal=false-color heat map (abstract)

act.doc: static=fixed time of day / cycle=dusk-to-night sweep across sections
